name: is_tagged_na
title: Test for a tagged missing value

origin.description: True where a double is a tagged missing value.

arguments.name: tag
arguments.text: A one-character tag. NULL accepts any tag.

origin.details: A plain NA and a non-double are not tagged. Only the first character of tag is used.
origin.value: A logical vector the same length as x.

translation.description: True where a double is a tagged missing value.
